name: LINCS / CMap L1000 Phase I and Phase II
paper: Subramanian A, 2017, Cell (PMID 29195078); GEO also lists PMID 33168813
cell_type: many cell lines. Skin fibroblast line MCH58 is in cell_info. No fibroblast overexpression screen.
cell_line_or_primary: MCH58 is a cell line, sample_type normal, subtype skin fibroblast, donor_age -666. HA1E is immortalized normal kidney. Large OE sets are in HEK293T, A375, PC3, HEPG2, HCC515, MCF7, HT29, VCAP, A549.
donor_age: MCH58 and HA1E donor_age are -666 (not a reported year). A375 is 54 on cell_info.
perturbation_type: ORF overexpression (trt_oe) and shRNA (trt_sh / cgs / css), plus compounds
n_lambert_tfs: Phase I signatures: 645 unique Lambert TFs in trt_oe; 557 unique Lambert TFs in shRNA. MCH58 has 0 OE and 1 Lambert knockdown (TCF7L2). HA1E has 284 OE and 531 knockdown Lambert TFs.
n_genes_measured: 978 landmark genes. gene_info has 12328 rows of which 11350 are not landmarks and were not counted as measured.
controls_same_batch: Y at cell_id level for the OE lines above (ctl_vector, ctl_vehicle, or ctl_untrt signatures exist for the same cell_id). Same-plate identity was not inspected cell by cell.
downloadable_format: processed Level 2-5 matrices on GEO. Level 3 and above include inferred genes.
approximate_size: Phase I sig_info was read locally after download; Phase II sig_info was not downloaded
verified_how: GEO quick SOFT for GSE92742 and GSE70138 opened. Phase I gene_info, cell_info, and sig_info (473647 signatures) were read and intersected with Lambert v1.01. Phase II cell_info has the same 98 cell ids as Phase I.
tier_reason: It is not a fibroblast overexpression screen (MCH58 has a single Lambert knockdown), the large overexpression sets are in cancer lines or immortalized kidney cells, and only 978 genes are measured landmarks, so more than one Tier A criterion fails.
